entries.label: YouTube serialized Shorts (episodic Shorts)
entries.why_it_works: Announced at Made On YouTube on 2026-09-23 and rolling out globally, it gives recurring-character series a native episodic container.
entries.how_to_adapt: Package each Inspector case as a numbered episode so the recurring 'she commits the same fault herself' reveal pays off across a case-file series.

entries.label: Subtle Foreshadowing (early teaser of the punchline)
entries.why_it_works: Planting the payoff early and repeating it rewards rewatches; the format dates to 2024 and an aggregator lists it again for October 2026, so treat as recurring rather than new.
entries.how_to_adapt: Show the Inspector's own fault (e.g. her unwiped ring on the counter) in the background of frame one while she inspects someone else's, so the camera notices before she does.

entries.label: 'Suspect' mock-pursuit narration
entries.why_it_works: A deadpan police-style label applied to a mundane person with a hyper-specific trait turns ordinary behaviour into a mock investigation.
entries.how_to_adapt: Keep only the mechanism of formal incident language applied to a trivial act, delivered by the Inspector in her own composed voice about a dripping tap or a crooked picture, without the running or call-out wording.

entries.label: 'Preparing for my Netflix documentary' mock-interview setup
entries.why_it_works: Fake documentary-interview staging (sit, clip mic, address camera) frames a petty story as weighty testimony; current-week peak status is unconfirmed.
entries.how_to_adapt: Do not reuse the meme wording; at most let the Inspector adjust an imaginary evidence lapel mic before gravely testifying about a loose cupboard handle, then reveal she loosened it.

entries.label: Specific-frame hook with immediate visual contrast or confession
entries.why_it_works: A vendor analysis says specific framing, visual contrast and confession openers beat generic openers, and that most high-click videos hook within the first 3 seconds (attributed there to TikTok for Business, not verified here).
entries.how_to_adapt: Open on a close shot of the micro-fault with the Inspector's formal case title card in the first 2 seconds, silent, with no spoken setup.
